section_summary.extract_value: This section reports on the internal consistency of the Dutch BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2), which demonstrated strong reliability with Cronbach's alpha of .90 and item-total correlations ranging from .32 to .78. The analysis indicates that removing Item 5 would have only marginally improved the alpha coefficient (from .90 to .91), confirming that the Dutch BAS-2 maintains acceptable internal consistency overall.
